valid_jump.name: Evidence-Driven Paradigm Shift
valid_jump.description: Evidence feedback disproves current assumption, triggering a non-trivial algorithmic or structural change that yields a verified performance leap.

trivial_microtune.name: Ineffective Parameter Micro-tuning ('原地微调')
trivial_microtune.description: Agent passes replan novelty check with minor constant tweaks (e.g., timeout limit 28s->27s, step size scaling) while fundamentally trapped in the same local optimum.

redundant_checkpoint.name: Ceremonial Todo Completion Replan
redundant_checkpoint.description: Replan triggered purely by completing 3 minor synthetic sub-todos without any new empirical evidence or external feedback.

premature_closure.name: Premature Closure ('无后续闭合幻觉')
premature_closure.description: Agent claims goal completion or stops execution (no_followup) while major acceptance criteria remain unmet on held-out or end-to-end tests.

recovery_rebound.name: State Recovery Rebound
recovery_rebound.description: Replan consumed primarily by restoring lost thread context, deserializing bulky state packets, or re-verifying environment integrity after transport failure.

official.note: Official SForge Codex operates within a single unmanaged session; implicit paradigm shifts happen in-context (e.g. C++ accelerator switch) rather than via external supervisor states.

native-goal.note: Native Codex /goal terminates prematurely once initially planned steps complete; lacks outer replan mechanism.

key_causal_episodes.observation: Score flatlined at 2075 -> 2039 (-1.7% change over 9.5 hours). 4 successive replans approved under 'keep current route' with minor parameter mutations.
key_causal_episodes.root_cause: Replan novelty contract accepted minor string diff in hypothesis without requiring empirical gradient or external metric divergence.
key_causal_episodes.remedy: External drift detector with teeth; reject replan proposals without new evidence citations or parameter perturbation magnitude exceeding threshold.

key_causal_episodes.observation: Score progressed from 2182 down to 1791 (lower is better). In-context exploration abandoned Python simulation and introduced C++ DP accelerator.
key_causal_episodes.root_cause: Unencumbered context allowed model to reconsider architectural strategy when fine-tuning stalled, without paying supervisor serialization round-trips.
key_causal_episodes.remedy: LoopX Stride strategy: switch branch when 2 consecutive effective turns yield delta < epsilon.

key_causal_episodes.observation: Model generated multiple degrading candidates in late hours; Explore state machine rejected candidate adoption, preserving historical best 49615495839.
key_causal_episodes.root_cause: Incumbent retention rule and validated state barrier prevented workspace corruption.
key_causal_episodes.remedy: Enforce strict incumbent isolation across all long-horizon profiles.

key_causal_episodes.observation: Stride strategy dynamically widened evaluation cadence after early steady progress, saving 34.2% protocol tokens while achieving best score 35.82.
key_causal_episodes.root_cause: Evidence-conditioned cadence replaces rigid todo-count clocks with progress-density clocks.
key_causal_episodes.remedy: Promote evidence_conditioned_v1 as default replan strategy.
